reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need it in a sachet to carry around. On $23k a year I'm not paying $25 to $30 a month to solve a problem I don't have.
objection: I already have a cheap magnesium bottle at home and I take it before bed there. Paying extra for a travel format I wouldn't use is just paying for packaging.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to what I pay now for a big bottle (around $12 to $15 for 30 days), or if I started forgetting my pills on trips often enough that the sachet saved me.
